implemented_contract.entry: Initial look alignment, actual FP state 0, one BeginSight per positive token; IsSightReady polled within 1.5 seconds.
implemented_contract.aim: Native owns in-session yaw/pitch/node writes; PSC caches validated CaptureAim(false) actual pose.
implemented_contract.shot: Ammo checked before atomic CaptureAim(true) freeze/snapshot; one native settle tick and cached native preflight; legacy three ticks retained.
implemented_contract.stale_result: Generation, token, phase, menu and ownership gates discard old reads/freezes/prepare/commit, Reset animation results, reload visual restoration returns and clock reads without releasing or changing a newer lease.
implemented_contract.clock: OnUpdate, PauseInput and ResumeInput publish lastTick only if the captured generation/token still owns the session; PauseInput captures generation after legitimate shot cancellation.
implemented_contract.input_ownership: RequestShot, RequestExit, InputReady, SetAimKey and event dispatch capture generation/token before external reads or Trace; stale callbacks cannot adopt a replacement lease or alter its input gates.
implemented_contract.thaw: Scoped token/generation on precommit cancellation, preparation failure and committed release; pending native boundaries block a replacement freeze on the same token.
implemented_contract.exit: EndSight before Session.Release, perspective/control restoration and visual/aim cleanup.
implemented_contract.exit_pose: One coherent cached ApplyAim after End and Release, protected by endingSession plus generation/token guards; next Begin uses that restored initial pose.
implemented_contract.load: Interrupted controller cleanup recovered through EmergencyCleanup; older stacks invalidated before restored 3D can launch or overwrite a new lease.
implemented_contract.legacy_aim: Mouse/arrow source paths are available only when UseSightCamera is explicitly false.

limits: Executes actual PSC scalar branches, array length/range checks and arithmetic with explicit native boundary fixtures.
Does not execute the Papyrus VM, DLL, scene graph, real input dispatch, frame scheduling or save serialization.
Native pose fixture represents last applied scene pose; native serialization/token isolation requires separate C++ evidence and game verification.
